reason: I cut hair myself in a one or two chair shop and count my own drawer every night, so the stylist check-ins, attendance and 'see from anywhere' parts are for a bigger salon than mine. ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month is real money on what I earn, for things my notebook and WhatsApp already do.
objection: Many of my customers won't give their mobile number, so the reminders, wallet and referral part won't work for half my walk-ins, and then I'm paying monthly for an app I mostly use as a bill book.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and a cheaper solo plan around ₹299 a month, so I can try it on my own shop first and see if regulars actually come back from the WhatsApp reminders.
